name: aldilivery
description: Aldilivery — a voice-first grocery messenger service for the United Kingdom.
author: Anthony Tochukwu Ibe

scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @aldilivery/api build && pnpm --filter @aldilivery/web build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @aldilivery/core test && pnpm --filter @aldilivery/api test && pnpm --filter @aldilivery/web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @aldilivery/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @aldilivery/web typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
